prompts.title: 首页
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity redesigned UI concept image for an existing Chinese WeChat mini-program called 日麻计分助手. This is a proposed redesign, not a screenshot of existing code. Cohesive visual system across the series: warm ivory #F7F5EF background, deep pine #153F32 primary, muted jade #527B67, ink #252C28, fine warm gray separators, restrained amber for score accents, small restrained red for negative values. Modern Japanese stationery sensibility; elegant Chinese serif only for page title, highly readable Chinese sans-serif for all controls, tabular numerals. Clean generous spacing, large tap targets, tidy hierarchy, subtle 16px corners and shadows. Ivory mahjong tiles with accurately recognizable dark-green bamboo, red characters, dark dot patterns. NO decorative room/photo background, no 3D tilted phones, no gradients everywhere, no giant logo wasting space, no invented avatars, no account/login/cloud/export/share/AI/recommendation/undo features. Native WeChat top navigation with back on subpages and top-right capsule, time 9:41 and safe bottom area; no invented bottom tab bar. Use sharp legible Simplified Chinese text. A polished landscape design presentation with two front-facing tall mobile screen artboards, each roughly 390x844 proportions, on a quiet ivory canvas. Modest header outside phones with page number and page name and concise state labels. Both screens fully visible and equal size. All shown records and numbers are illustrative.
Page 01 首页. Left state label 默认首页: compact typographic masthead 日麻计分助手 with small square 雀 mark, subtitle 符数 · 番数 · 点数. Hero action card 快速计分 / 输入手牌，算清每一分 with small ivory mahjong tile vignette and a clear 开始计分 button. Secondary rows 对局管理 / 新建四人对局, 役种速查 / 查番数与成立条件, 历史对局 / 查看记录与结算. Footer discreet tappable 意见反馈, plus reference text 参考规则：雀魂. Right state label 有进行中的对局: same layout but concise prominent continuation card directly beneath masthead labelled 对局进行中, 东2局 · 1本场, four small names 東家 南家 西家 北家, main 继续对局 button and secondary 新建对局 link. New-game link should show no network or room invitation. Remaining four entry actions still visible, feedback footer visible. Preserve five entry capabilities and resume existing local game. No statistics or win rate. Visually recognizable as useful compact redesign of a green/ivory scoring app, not a marketing landing page.
